english.note: Use 一部分 as the all-purpose everyday way to refer to one divided piece when the subdivision structure need not be stressed.
Use 一部分 for an ordinary quantity or section that is merely part of a whole, not for a calculated ratio.
Use this as the general choice for a part or portion of a whole, especially an abstract one.

examples.english: This piece is only one subdivision of the whole cake, not the whole thing.
examples.traditional: 呢塊蛋糕只係成個蛋糕嘅一部分，唔係全部。

examples.english: A proportion of the company's income goes toward rent.
examples.traditional: 公司收入嘅一部分用嚟交租。

examples.english: This is only a parcel of the report.
examples.traditional: 呢個只係報告嘅一部分。
